model.name: LFM2.5-230M
model.quantization: BF16 weights, F32 dense compute; ternary-v1 packed variant added in iteration 002

measurement.memoryScope: Whole process (max RSS via /usr/bin/time -l). F32-expanded weights alone are ~0.86 GiB by allocation math; KV cache at 1024 tokens is ~24 MiB.
measurement.notes: Iteration 001 (baseline): cold-start CLI, parses ~438 MiB BF16 safetensors and expands to F32. TTFT includes model load plus prompt processing. Output speed = (32−1 tokens) / (t₃₂ − t₁) = 31 / 10.95 s. Correctness: llama.cpp b11046 CPU f32-KV oracle, 118/118 teacher-forced positions top-1 agreement, max abs logit delta 0.33; 330/332 generated ids agree, both disagreements at near-ties. Iteration 002 (ternary packed path): correctness gate is bitwise — packed_linear/packed_gather_rows and the fully packed executor produce identical logits to the dequantized minifield.ternary.v1 weights through the dense path (fixture vectors + generated 2-layer model + multi-group rows). Real-artifact run: packed safetensors (58.3 MiB) loads in 0.42 s vs dense (438.2 MiB) in 3.39 s (parse+decode+upload from memory); a 26-token teacher-forced pass runs 6.74 s packed vs 8.82 s dense (3.71 vs 2.84 tokens/s decode-equivalent, ~270 vs ~353 ms/token). Packed codes stay U8 in RAM so resident weights track file size; dense expands to F32 (~0.86 GiB). Speedup is weight-bandwidth, not kernel math — the scalar kernel does the same MAC count plus unpacking. Quality caveat: naive absmax-RTN ternary gives 0/26 top-1 agreement vs dense (max logit delta ~24) — expected for 230M without QAT; quality is a training-side concern, the runtime path itself is bit-exact vs its own dequantization. Iteration 003 (wgpu F32 backend): new engines/backend-wgpu crate runs the full dense model on GPU. Correctness gate is bitwise — 12/12 teacher-forced top-1 positions match CPU with max logit delta 0.0000 on the real bundle. Measured: wgpu load (device init + F32 upload) 3.89 s vs CPU 3.16 s; 12-token teacher-forced run 0.53 s vs 4.02 s (20.9 vs 2.87 tokens/s decode-equivalent, ~48 vs ~365 ms/token) — 7.7x on GPU before any fusion or quantization, despite ~240 recorded dispatches/token. Op-level parity: 12/12 tests vs backend-cpu on Metal. Iteration 004 (NEON SIMD ternary matvec): new crates/kernels-simd provides the packed-linear inner dot; scoped-unsafe NEON on aarch64, scalar fallback elsewhere. Correctness gate relaxed from bitwise to declared reorder tolerance 1e-4 (observed ~1e-6) since SIMD changes f32 accumulation order; all products stay exact. Gather/decode stays bitwise. Measured on the real packed bundle: 26-token teacher-forced run 0.96 s vs 6.74 s scalar (7.0x, 25.99 vs 3.71 tokens/s decode-equivalent) and vs 8.68 s dense (9.0x). Packed top-1 token sequence is identical to the scalar run, so reorder changed no argmax. AVX2 and the persistent thread pool remain open; wasm32 SIMD128 is T6. Iteration 005 (wgpu ternary): backend-wgpu now implements the full packed path — upload_u8_classified (byte-exact U8 storage), packed_linear (PACKED_GEMV: one workgroup per output element over a flattened m*n grid, 256-thread k-reduction, codes bound as u32 words over the byte stream) and packed_gather_rows (PACKED_GATHER dequant). Gate: real packed bundle teacher-forced on both backends, 12/12 top-1 agree, final-position max logit delta 0.0001 vs CPU NEON. Measured: wgpu packed 12-token run 0.56 s vs CPU packed 0.43 s (21.3 vs 27.6 tokens/s) — GPU packed matches GPU dense (~0.53 s) because the unfused ~240 dispatches/token dominate; weight-bandwidth savings only pay off after T8 decode fusion. Synthetic parity: packed_linear incl. a 70_000-row flattened-grid case and packed_gather (bitwise) vs backend-cpu. Iteration 006 (decode fusion): four fused InferenceOps land on both backends: add_row_rms_norm (residual add + norm, two outputs), packed_linear_pair (K/V and gate/up share one input pass), packed_swiglu_linear (SiLU(gate)*up inside the down-projection GEMV), qk_norm_rope (per-head RMS + split-half rotary for Q and K over a shared host cos/sin table). gated_short_convolution now consumes the fused [tokens, 3*hidden] projection directly, removing 3 rect copies per conv layer. Executor restructured around a loop-carried (residual, normed) pair; the last layer's fused norm uses the embedding-norm weight so no separate final norm pass runs. Dispatch count drops from ~240 to ~115 per decode token (conv 8->4, attn ~10->6, FFN ~8->3 per layer). Dense path semantics unchanged; fused ops decompose into the reference passes on CPU so scalar math is preserved. Gate: real packed bundle teacher-forced wgpu vs CPU, 12/12 top-1, final-position max logit delta 0.0001; dense wgpu vs CPU 12/12, delta 0.0000; 19/19 wgpu parity tests incl. all four fused kernels vs backend-cpu. Measured: wgpu packed 12-token run 0.47 s vs 0.56 s unfused (25.4 vs 21.3 tokens/s). Remaining dispatches are dominated by per-op fixed costs (bind group, uniform write, pass encode) plus GQA cache-append copies; GQA megakernel, on-device argmax, and single-readback remain open. Iteration 007 (deferred-op batching + on-device greedy decode): two structural overheads removed. First, per-dispatch costs: device.rs now records ops into a pending list and replays them at submit, merging consecutive dispatches into one compute pass and staging all uniform params in a single Queue::write_buffer (~115 write_buffer calls and ~115 Metal encoders per token collapse to ~15 passes and 1 uniform write). Second, logits roundtrips: a new argmax op reduces each fresh logits row to one f32 (the first strict maximum's index; NaN when the row held any non-finite value, so the publish readback doubles as the finiteness check). The per-token validation readback shrinks from the full 65536-entry logits row (~256 KB, mapped twice per token: once for finiteness validation and once for host-side greedy selection) to a single 4-byte sampled-id map. The sampled id feeds the next append's embedding gather on-device via TokenIds::Device; TokenExecutor gains sampled_token/append_argmax so the generation loop never reads a logits row. Gate: real packed bundle teacher-forced wgpu vs CPU 12/12 top-1, final-position max logit delta 0.0001; dense wgpu vs CPU 12/12; 20/20 wgpu parity tests including argmax (tie-break, non-finite NaN marking) and device-id gather chains. Measured on the real bundle: wgpu packed 12-token run 0.294 s vs 0.473 s in iteration 006 (40.8 vs 25.4 tokens/s); wgpu dense 0.176 s (~68 tokens/s). The 4-byte map sync per token remains the residual serialization point.

evidence: Oracle gate: crates/executor-core/tests/oracle_lfm25.rs @ c3400ba (env-gated, MINIFIELD_LFM25_BUNDLE_DIR + MINIFIELD_LFM25_ORACLE_DIR). Capture tooling: scripts/oracle/ @ c3400ba. Oracle: llama.cpp b11046 CPU-only, f32 KV, temp 0, 6 prompts, artifacts hashed in tmp/oracle/manifest.json. Timing: /usr/bin/time -l on minifield-infer, prompt 'Tell me about yourself.', BOS on. Iteration 002 evidence: crates/executor-core/tests/packed_ternary.rs on branch ternary/t4-packed-linear (committed fixture crates/executor-core/tests/fixtures/ternary-v1-001/ + generated in-memory model); real-artifact run env-gated on MINIFIELD_LFM25_PACKED=tmp/models/lfm2.5-230m/lfm2.5-230m-ternary-v1.safetensors (61,132,272 B, produced by training/ sample exporter on branch ternary-export-v1) vs model.safetensors (459,401,112 B). Load timings measure parse+decode+upload from in-memory bytes, file IO excluded. Iteration 003 evidence: engines/backend-wgpu (wgpu 30.0.1) tests/parity.rs (12 ops, Metal adapter) and tests/executor_parity.rs (env-gated MINIFIELD_LFM25_BUNDLE_DIR, real model.safetensors, wgpu vs cpu teacher-forced logits). Timings from Instant around load and run inside the release test. Iteration 004 evidence: crates/kernels-simd (NEON group dot via vld4-deinterleaved f32 path) wired into backend-cpu packed_linear; crates/executor-core/tests/packed_ternary.rs tolerance gate REORDER_TOLERANCE=1e-4 (gather stays bitwise); real-artifact run env-gated as in iteration 002, release build. Iteration 005 evidence: engines/backend-wgpu PACKED_GEMV/PACKED_GATHER kernels + upload_u8_classified; tests/parity.rs packed_linear/packed_gather/invalid-operand cases vs backend-cpu; tests/executor_parity.rs wgpu_packed_executor_matches_cpu_on_real_model (env-gated MINIFIELD_LFM25_BUNDLE_DIR + MINIFIELD_LFM25_PACKED, release build). Iteration 006 evidence: branch ternary/t8-decode-fusion; engines/backend-wgpu kernels PACKED_GEMV_PAIR, PACKED_SWIGLU_GEMV, ADD_NORM, QK_NORM_ROPE + rewritten CONV_GATE/CONV; tests/parity.rs fused-op cases; tests/executor_parity.rs env-gated real bundle run (release). CPU fused ops in crates/backend-cpu decompose to reference passes. Iteration 007 evidence: engines/backend-wgpu/src/device.rs pending-op replay (dispatch merging + batched uniform staging), argmax kernel + TokenIds::Device gather path, executor argmax epilogue with 4-byte publish readback; crates/executor-core/tests/packed_ternary.rs append_argmax_extends_prefix_with_resolved_greedy_token (sampled token equals logits argmax, state bitwise-identical to append_known); engines/backend-wgpu/tests/parity.rs argmax/device-id cases on Metal; real-artifact timings from the env-gated executor_parity tests, release build.
